summary: Capri Global Capital announced that its members have considered and approved raising funds up to Rs 4,000 crore through a postal ballot. The intimation was made under Regulations 30 and 51 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. This capital infusion could support the non-banking financial company's future lending expansion and business growth. Retail investors should monitor how the company deploys this capital and potential equity dilution.
